<!-- pr-reviewer: 9ad5ffb1a630db0345f23f65ec88dd574bd4ac0a -->
Review result: CLEAN. No changes are required before merge.

The seven added names stop the reader from silently discarding drawable records in sections without geometry. The SUN exclusion preserves object import. Both new tests check the intended behavior. I read the complete diff and issue #3683. I checked the current rules from upstream main.

Local results use a clean trial merge with upstream main `97a676e5c2307f7a2bc3c7677d1cbe334df8ef40`. The trial merge is `96bdd6588605e6d13438bee510c3fcff02a5176f`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. Geometry changes select the batch plan. All 1,211 steps passed; no steps stalled. Builds, UI suites, and clippy with `-D warnings` passed.
- DXF suites: `dxf` 17 passed; `dxf_classes_section` 9 passed; `dxf_objects_section` 6 passed; `dxf_inert_sections` 4 passed; `dxf_refusals` 15 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: PASS. All 6 steps passed. The 11 light tests passed; no steps stalled.
- Catalog checks in the quick gate: `example_catalog` 43 passed, 4 ignored; `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed; `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed.
- The Windows failures named in the body did not occur here. Both `sinumerik_810m_post` suites, `catalog_render`, and `egui_app` passed on Linux.

**Extra suites run**

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 29 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`: 7 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed, 0 failed.

**Safety checks**

I ran two mutations in a separate source copy under `/tmp`. The review worktree stayed unchanged.

1. Remove `MPOLYGON` from `ENTITY_KINDS`: the new skipped-section test failed because the parser accepted the file. Expected red result.
2. Add `SUN` to `ENTITY_KINDS`: the new SUN test failed with `SUN: graphical entity in OBJECTS`. Expected red result.

After I restored the source copy, both complete test suites passed: 15 tests, 0 failed.

Goldens moved: none. This PR changes no recorded programs or UI files. Full heavy lanes are not required for this P7 change.

Findings: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand. Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3968 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
`merge-ready` set: the collaborator review of head `9ad5ffb1a` is clean, the PR is ready (not a draft) and GitHub reports MERGEABLE. The label was not set when the review ran.
